behavior.guard: null pointer returns error; blob count >=20001 returns error
behavior.perBlob: iterates original blob count, evaluates area/centroid/center/angle/box/perimeter/axis/circularity/rectangularity predicates against enable/limit state
behavior.writes: writes one uint status per blob into this+0x15d98 and ANDs aggregate into this+0x15da0

conclusion: LimitJudge changes judgment/status bits only. It is not the source of VM BlobCount or TotalArea reduction.
limitations: Field offsets and helper predicate details are native ABI evidence from decompilation.
This does not resolve VM input/ROI/mask differences.
